description: The Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority (RURA) publishes water and sanitation sector statistics as a list of report files on its website. On 27 September 2026 the first page listed quarterly water statistics reports for the second quarter of 2024, the first quarter of 2024, the fourth, third and second quarters of 2023 and the fourth quarter of 2022, and reports as of September 2022, June 2022, June 2021 and March 2021, each of 156 to 408 KB; the list runs to four pages. Coverage is Rwanda's regulated water and sanitation sector. Access is free as downloadable reports. Caveats: the reports were not opened, so their indicators are not described here; the latest listed report is for the second quarter of 2024. Simulation uses: sector statistics for water supply planning and benchmarking in Rwanda. Related records: WASREB Kenya performance data (data-wasreb-kenya-water-service-provider-performance) and SUNASS benchmarking (data-sunass-peru-utility-benchmarking).
